newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch ING to advise Russian Dalrybbank.
newsitem.headline: Dutch ING to advise Russian Dalrybbank.

text.p: ING Bank said on Tuesday it had signed a cooperative agreement with Russia's Dalrybbank.
"Under the arrangement, ING Bank will give technical assistance and access to training programmes to Dalrybbank," the banking arm of the Internationale Nederlanden Groep (ING) said.

The project covers strategy, organisation, credit management, information technology, international banking, investments, human resources management and other areas. It is expected to last about two years.

ING said the "twinning agreement" is part of the Financial Institutions Development Project, which is funded by the World Bank, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and the European Union.
Vladivostok-based Dalrybbank has 10 branches and employs about 650 people.
The bank is rapidly expanding its business domestically and through a network of international correspondent banks, ING Bank said.
